variants.B: v8.6 without the ridge ML sleeve (other sleeves, weighting and vol targeting unchanged, re-run through CS.portfolio_v5)

data: paper_v5.py _dump (v86, cutoff 2026-10-01, research pack), proven identical to results/cache_v86_final.parquet
scaling: both scaled to 15% vol on 2022-24 daily
decision_window: 2022-2024 (prop) / 2022-2024 Sharpe; 2025-26 reported once, not used to choose
